text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
DAILY TIMES - Former Minister of Education Sam Mpasu has
put his immediate juniors under pressure to overlook certain acquisition procedures in order to ensure that the UK based Fieldyork International wins the tender to supply notebooks in Malawi.
"We found out that Sam Mpasu had been having regular telephone conversations with officials of Fieldyork," Charles Simango," editor-in-chief of The Democrat said in testimony as defence witness.
Mpasu, now the ruling United Democratic Front (UDF) party secretary general claimed he was dropped from cabinet because of the newspaper story and has sued for defamation.
